cases.caption: A green parrot on a wooden branch, vivid plumage, natural color.
A bright orange bicycle leaning against a pale blue wall.
A blue cup to the left of a red apple on a wooden table, daylight.
A small child and a golden retriever walking together along a beach.
A brown tabby cat sitting in a sunlit window, detailed whiskers.
A farmer holding a basket of vegetables beside a field.

A dark-skinned man with a beard and short dark hair stands centered in an outdoor urban setting, looking directly forward. He wears dark oval sunglasses, a gold-colored patterned choker necklace, and silver hoop earrings in both ears. He is dressed in a loose-fitting white garment, resembling a robe or tunic, with long sleeves. A brown leather pouch with a fur texture and decorative tassels is slung across his body, resting on his right hip, with his hands clasped over it. The background is blurred, showing a crowd of people in a street. To the man's right, another man with a beard is partially visible, wearing a gray t-shirt. Buildings with orange and white facades are visible further back under an overcast sky.

A woman sits on a couch with three children. The woman is holding a baby on her lap while a toddler looks at a tablet. To the right, two boys are seated on the couch; one is wearing glasses and looking at the tablet, while the other is reading a book. A blue blanket is draped over the legs of the two boys. A framed piece of artwork with text hangs on the wall behind them.
